hypothesis: Separate causal LONG and SHORT regime families may isolate directional edge that is diluted in the pooled Flat v7.2 universe.

frozen_execution.entry: next 15m open after completed signal bar

regime_inputs.availability: all features must be known at or before signal close
regime_inputs.trend: completed 4h EMA50 versus EMA200 and EMA50 slope
regime_inputs.structure: completed 4h close versus prior completed 20-bar range midpoint
regime_inputs.volatility: completed 1h ATR14 percentile over trailing 90 completed 1h bars

predeclared_families.name: LONG_BULL_TREND_ONLY
predeclared_families.gate: 4h EMA50 > EMA200, EMA50 rising, completed close above prior range midpoint

predeclared_families.name: LONG_BULL_OR_NEUTRAL_SOFT_RISK
predeclared_families.risk: 1.00 in bull, 0.70 in neutral, 0.40 in bear

predeclared_families.name: SHORT_BEAR_TREND_ONLY
predeclared_families.gate: 4h EMA50 < EMA200, EMA50 falling, completed close below prior range midpoint

predeclared_families.name: SHORT_BEAR_OR_NEUTRAL_SOFT_RISK
predeclared_families.risk: 1.00 in bear, 0.70 in neutral, 0.40 in bull

development_gate.selection_rule: At most one passing candidate across both directional families: highest pooled PF, then lowest DD, then highest positive-fold percentage, then most trades, then name.

anti_overfit_rules: No candidate additions or coefficient changes after viewing development results.
No manual symbol exclusions or winner-only subsets.
LONG and SHORT families use identical costs, portfolio accounting and fold boundaries.
If all six candidates block, proceed to separately preregistered formal causal Cleanshot/SMC features.
next_action: Implement and run exactly the six preregistered candidates under strict OOS.
